transport.processing: Offline selected source-road corridors intersected with pavement; subtract buildings, medians, retained non-Open road surfaces and active curbs. Conservative connected component, full-footprint route sampling; runtime boundary and swept checks. Route points form an ordered vehicle graph.
transport.extent: Central Avenue / City Parkway slice only; other rendered streets are not enabled for cars.

retained: All earlier public snapshot bytes and City Centre extent are unchanged. No runtime mapping service.
originalAssets: Original MIT compact passenger cars, wheel/light animation, train cars and platform lights; no copied proprietary models, branding or audio.
